name: RiteChoice23 Notification
author: RiteChoice23
description: A private, searchable, keyboard-driven notification center for the Omarchy top bar.

barWidget.description: Searchable history, safe app focus, DND, privacy controls, and durable media

schema.label: Keep at most
schema.description: Maximum archived notifications. The age and count limits are both enforced.

schema.label: Keep notifications for
schema.description: Days before archived notifications and their media are removed.

schema.label: Unread marker
schema.description: Show a subtle dot, an unread count, or no marker on the bar bell.

schema.label: Clicking a notification
schema.description: Auto opens a validated archived image or focuses the best matching existing window. Stored shell commands are never executed.

schema.label: Show message text
schema.description: Turn off message bodies when the screen may be visible to other people.

schema.label: Keep and show pictures
schema.description: When disabled, cached notification pictures are purged while app icons are retained.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: Preferred panel width; it is clamped to the available screen space.
